title: The Bottle Rocket
text_content: Chioma spent three weeks building a rocket for the science competition, and it was made from a plastic bottle, a bicycle pump, and some colourful paper. Her teacher promised that the winner would represent the school in Lagos. On the morning of the competition, Chioma carried the rocket carefully across the crowded playground. Her classmates gathered around the table, whispering with excitement, while the judges walked slowly along the rows of different experiments. When they reached Chioma, she explained that air pressure would push out the water inside and lift the rocket. Then she pumped the handle again and again until the pressure was strong enough, and the rocket shot upward with a loud hiss and landed in the football field. Everyone cheered, and the judges wrote busily in their notebooks. Later that afternoon, the headmaster announced the winners in front of the entire school. Chioma could hardly believe it, and her heart pounded when she heard her name. She had never imagined that a simple bottle could take her so far. Chioma understood that patience and careful practice are just as important as a clever idea. That night, she looked up at the bright stars and dreamed of building a real rocket.
